```{python}
#| label: fig-physical-coating-extents
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Incremental top and side offsets versus cumulative field height in the `ihp-sg13cmos5l` recipe. Vertical dimensions follow the source; the wire width is illustrative."
#| fig-alt: "TopMetal1 is surrounded first by pass1 oxide, then by pass2 nitride. Above the wire the coatings add 1.5 and 0.4 micrometres. In the field their outer heights are 1.5 and 1.9 micrometres from the metal bottom."
import drawsvg as dw
w,h=940,390
d=dw.Drawing(w,h,origin=(0,80))
d.append(dw.Rectangle(0,80,w,h,fill='white'))
ink='#183247';base=360;scale=55
left,right=410,590
metal_top=base-2*scale

def text(s,x,y,size=18,anchor='start'):
    d.append(dw.Text(s,size,x,y,text_anchor=anchor,fill=ink,font_family='sans-serif'))

def envelope(side,top,field,color):
    x1,x2=left-side*scale,right+side*scale
    yt,yf=base-(2+top)*scale,base-field*scale
    points=[(210,base),(210,yf),(x1,yf),(x1,yt),(x2,yt),(x2,yf),(780,yf),(780,base)]
    d.append(dw.Lines(*[v for xy in points for v in xy],close=True,fill=color,stroke=ink,stroke_width=1.2))
envelope(.6,1.9,1.9,'#ddd0ec')
envelope(.3,1.5,1.5,'#d5e9f7')
d.append(dw.Rectangle(left,metal_top,right-left,base-metal_top,fill='#b7d8bf',stroke=ink,stroke_width=1.5))
text('TopMetal1',500,310,20,'middle')
text('pass1',500,211,18,'middle')
text('pass2',500,131,18,'middle')
d.append(dw.Line(500,137,500,151,stroke=ink,stroke_width=1))
text('pass1 in field',230,321,17)
text('pass2 in field',765,236,17,'end')
d.append(dw.Line(715,241,715,266,stroke=ink,stroke_width=1))

def dimension(x,yt,yb,label,tx,anchor):
    d.append(dw.Line(x,yt,x,yb,stroke=ink,stroke_width=1.4))
    for y in (yt,yb):d.append(dw.Line(x-5,y,x+5,y,stroke=ink,stroke_width=1.4))
    text(label,tx,(yt+yb)/2+5,17,anchor)
dimension(180,base-1.9*scale,base,'1.9 µm',164,'end')
text('Field extent',165,237,16,'end')
dimension(830,base-3.9*scale,base-3.5*scale,'0.4 µm',846,'start')
dimension(830,base-3.5*scale,metal_top,'1.5 µm',846,'start')
dimension(830,metal_top,base,'2.0 µm',846,'start')
text('Top increments',829,112,16,'middle')
d.append(dw.Line(165,base,838,base,stroke=ink,stroke_width=1,stroke_dasharray='5,4'))
text('Root bottom: z = 5.4 µm',210,397,18)
text('Field top: 5.4 + 1.9 = 7.3 µm',210,430,18)
text('Side reach: 0.3 + 0.3 = 0.6 µm',540,430,18)
d
```
